'''Ungr''' was the second [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Honoghr (star)|Honoghr]] in<ref name="EA" /> the turbulent<ref name="DF">''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Honoghr system/Legends|Honoghr system]],<ref name="EA" /> located in the [[Kessel sector/Legends|Kessel sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Ungr was a toxic rock with four [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Honoghr system/Legends|Honoghr system]], except [[Logru]], [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]], and [[Kuthul]], were first introduced in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EA" />
